from pathlib import Path
import base64, gzip, hashlib

root = Path("samples/source")
parts = [root / f"botanical-engraving-150.svg.gz.b64.part{i:02d}" for i in range(3)]
for p in parts:
    if not p.is_file():
        raise SystemExit(f"missing source fragment: {p}")
payload = "".join(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8") for p in parts)
raw = gzip.decompress(base64.b64decode(payload))
expected = "107bfd3e20533d739669aaa848afdb8f07db455707a97da18197f3af61df9c8f"
actual = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
if actual != expected:
    raise SystemExit(f"source SHA mismatch: {actual}")
out = Path.home() / "Desktop" / "botanical-engraving-150.svg"
out.write_bytes(raw)
print(f"SOURCE_OK path={out} sha256={actual} bytes={len(raw)}")

uv run python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, tempfile, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import kobra_plot as kp

src = Path.home() / "Desktop" / "botanical-engraving-150.svg"
gcode_path = Path.home() / "Desktop" / "botanical-engraving-150-kobra.gcode"
preview_path = Path.home() / "Desktop" / "botanical-engraving-150-kobra-preview.svg"
report_path = Path.home() / "Desktop" / "botanical-engraving-150-kobra-report.json"

profile = kp.load_profile()
page_w = page_h = 150.0
page_x = 38.0
page_y = 58.0

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="botanical-exact-") as td:
    normalized = Path(td) / "normalized.svg"
    kp.normalize_svg(src, normalized)
    lines = kp.load_normalized_svg(normalized)
    root = ET.parse(normalized).getroot()
    vb = root.attrib.get("viewBox")
    if not vb:
        raise SystemExit("normalized SVG missing viewBox")
    vx, vy, vw, vh = [float(x) for x in vb.replace(",", " ").split()]
    if vw <= 0 or vh <= 0:
        raise SystemExit(f"bad normalized viewBox: {vb}")

    mapped = []
    for line in lines:
        out = []
        for x, y in line:
            px = (x - vx) / vw * page_w
            py = (y - vy) / vh * page_h
            if profile.orientation.swap_xy:
                px, py = py, px
            if profile.orientation.flip_x:
                px = page_w - px
            if profile.orientation.flip_y:
                py = page_h - py
            out.append((page_x + px, page_y + py))
        mapped.append(out)

    before = len(mapped)
    mapped = kp.merge_touching_polylines(mapped, tolerance_mm=0.02)
    after = len(mapped)
    b = kp.bounds(mapped)
    ws = profile.workspace
    if not (
        ws.draw_min_x <= b.min_x <= b.max_x <= ws.draw_max_x
        and ws.draw_min_y <= b.min_y <= b.max_y <= ws.draw_max_y
    ):
        raise SystemExit(f"mapped botanical bounds outside safe envelope: {b}")

    gcode = kp.generate_gcode(mapped, profile)
    safety = kp.validate_gcode(gcode, profile)
    stats = kp.geometry_stats(mapped, profile)
    stats["output_bounds"] = b.as_dict()
    stats["polylines_before_touch_merge"] = before
    stats["polylines_after_touch_merge"] = after

    gcode_path.write_text(gcode, encoding="utf-8")
    preview_path.write_text(kp.render_preview(mapped, profile), encoding="utf-8")

    report = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "title": "Botanical engraving 150x150",
        "bounds_mm": {
            "min_x": round(b.min_x, 2),
            "max_x": round(b.max_x, 2),
            "min_y": round(b.min_y, 2),
            "max_y": round(b.max_y, 2),
        },
        "source": {
            "filename": src.name,
            "sha256": hashlib.sha256(src.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            "page_mm": [page_w, page_h],
            "machine_page_origin_mm": [page_x, page_y],
        },
        "geometry": stats,
        "profile": {
            "pen_up_z": profile.tool.pen_up_z,
            "pen_down_z": profile.tool.pen_down_z,
            "travel_feed": profile.motion.travel_feed,
            "draw_feed": profile.motion.draw_feed,
            "z_feed": profile.motion.z_feed,
        },
        "safety": safety,
    }
    report["gcode_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(gcode.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    report_path.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print("BOTANICAL_GEOMETRY", json.dumps(stats, sort_keys=True))
    print("BOTANICAL_PROFILE", json.dumps(report["profile"], sort_keys=True))
    print("BOTANICAL_GCODE_SHA256", report["gcode_sha256"])
PY

G="$HOME/Desktop/botanical-engraving-150-kobra.gcode"
R="$HOME/Desktop/botanical-engraving-150-kobra-report.json"
SHA=$(shasum -a 256 "$G" | awk '{print $1}')

uv run kobra-live "$G" --report "$R" --profile config/kobra2_neo_pen.toml --expect-sha256 "$SHA" --validate-only

PORT=""
if [ -e /dev/cu.usbserial-130 ]; then
  PORT=/dev/cu.usbserial-130
else
  PORT=$(uv run python - <<'PY'
import glob
from kobra_live import PosixSerial, _identify
for p in sorted(glob.glob("/dev/cu.usbserial-*")):
    try:
        with PosixSerial(p) as s:
            _identify(s)
        print(p)
        break
    except Exception:
        pass
PY
)
fi
test -n "$PORT"
echo "KOBRA_PORT=$PORT"

if command -v lsof >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  OWNERS=$(lsof -t "$PORT" 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ -n "$OWNERS" ]; then
    echo "BLOCKED: serial port already owned by pid(s): $OWNERS"
    lsof "$PORT" || true
    exit 41
  fi
fi

uv run kobra-live "$G" --report "$R" --profile config/kobra2_neo_pen.toml --port "$PORT" --expect-sha256 "$SHA" --progress-every 150 --thermal-check-every 300
echo RESULT:BOTANICAL_PRINT_COMPLETE
